name: The Sixth Grader at the Stairs
title: Calamity Encounter!
eventName: The Sixth Grader at the Stairs!
description: a kid two years older, three inches taller, blocking the stairs. you need to go up. they need someone to push around.
appearance: you see them at the top of the stairs. uniform untucked. smile that hasn't earned the right to be there.
thatMoment: the moment your foot touches the first step.

forgedEquipment.name: Bully's Shadow
forgedEquipment.desc: you walk past stairs without flinching now. sometimes you hear laughter. it's probably nothing.
